correctness.rationale: For defender support H, every nondefender cell has exactly row-degree a_i+column-degree b_j adjacent twos, so zero eligibility is exactly the a_i+b_j=1 cells. All remaining nondefenders are forced ones; the only threats to the induced-positive-subgraph totality are a singleton defender or the unique uncovered corner when H is a matching leaving one row and one column uncovered. Subtracting the all-zero optional labeling only in those cases proves the entire polynomial z^(pq)+sum_H z^(2|H|+b)[(1+z)^u-epsilon(H)]. The argument handles (2,2) separately; independent literal-definition ternary enumeration for boards 2x2, 2x3 and 3x3 matches all polynomial coefficients, and 2x2 has 13 minimal weight-4 functions. The published scalar minimum 2p follows from a separate row support bound and is not claimed novel.
